name: api-client
title: API client
description: Envelope-aware axios instance with bearer-token auth in memory (no localStorage), httpOnly refresh-cookie rotation, cold-start session bootstrap that tells a signed-out user, a blocked account and an unreachable backend apart, a single request gate that renews an expiring token, single-flight 401 retry, ADR-048 coded auth-failure classification (SessionFailureKind / CODE_TO_KIND), and UI-agnostic onError/onSessionExpired hooks. Split into protocol / failure / session-store / error-channel / refresh-exchange / client / replay modules behind one public surface.
postInstall: Call bootstrapSession() from your entry route and branch on its status: authenticated -> render the app, anonymous -> send to login, unavailable -> stay on the page with a retry (an unreachable backend is not a logout; fewbie ADR-001 / devbie ADR-040). Do not schedule a token refresh timer: axios requests renew an expiring token through the request gate, and raw-fetch transports (SSE streams) must read the token with getFreshAccessToken() rather than getAccessToken(). Adjust BASE_URL / legacy storage keys / REFRESH_PATH inside src/lib/api-client/ to match your backend contract.
